_설명: 천일문 2권 Chapter 02 시제 Chapter Test 뒷부분(17~23번)에서 가져와 변형한 문항. 기본 2과 시제 자리에 합쳐 둔다.

points.point: 현재완료와 과거를 나타내는 부사는 같이 쓸 수 없다

questions.prompt: 다음 중 주어진 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것을 고르세요.

choices.text: She lived in Busan for three years ago.
She lived in Busan since three years ago.
She has lived in Busan for three years ago.
She has lived in Busan for three years.
She has living in Busan since three years ago.

questions.prompt: 주어진 단어를 사용하여 시제에 맞게 문장을 완성하세요.
body: A: I (1) ________ (swim) in the sea with my brother last summer.
B: Oh, you had a great time. I (2) ________ (never, swim) in the sea.
A: Really? Then, I will teach you.

questions.point_label: 현재완료는 과거 부사구와 함께 쓸 수 없다
questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장을 고르세요.

choices.text: A spider has eight legs.
He has written a letter last night.
My friends are going to arrive here soon.
The teacher has ended the class already.
Ben is washing the dishes now.

questions.point_label: just와 ago는 함께 쓸 수 없다
questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장을 고르세요.

choices.text: She is eating lunch now.
I lost my key yesterday.
I have been sick for two weeks.
He has just finished his homework an hour ago.
They have traveled the world for 5 years.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 현재완료의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 문장을 고르세요.

choices.text: My friend has gone to Canada.
My dad has fixed his bike twice.
Jim has used the tablet since 2019.
She has already booked a ticket.
He has worked as a nurse for three years.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 현재완료의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 문장을 고르세요.
body: <보기> I [[have studied]] Chinese for two years.

choices.text: We have gone camping five times.
They have just heard the news.
He has never worn a suit.
Ted has forgotten the promise.
We have helped the elderly since last year.

questions.prompt: 다음 대화에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 두 개를 찾아 그 기호를 쓰고 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: A: ⓐ [[Have you been]] to that new bakery downtown?
B: Yes, it’s great! My friend, Mina ⓑ [[have worked]] at the bakery ⓒ [[since]] last month.
A: Oh, really? How was the bread?
B: I ⓓ [[eat]] a piece of bread there yesterday, and it was really delicious.
A: ⓔ [[I’m going to]] try it soon!
